verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's open.gsa.gov pages document concrete public API endpoints (Entity, Opportunities, Exclusions, Contracts, Federal Hierarchy, Assistance Listings) and a key-issuance path via the account-details 'Public API Key' field. The same public page carries an 'API Key Rate Limits' section, so all three parts of the story are documented first-party. missing for 10: the actual rate-limit values are not quoted in evidence (only the section's existence), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of key issuance or limits.

support.subject: As a developer, the service documents a public API for its data — published endpoints, a key-issuance path, and stated rate limits on its own pages

citations.quote: registered users must obtain the API Key from the https://sam.gov/workspace/profile/account-details page using the field, “Public API Key”.
